scope: New learner/checkpoint and persistent JSONL forward-pass SOFTWARE preflight only. Synthetic vectors/rewards and bounded unit gradient updates; no plant/policy trial or real training dataset.
hypothesis: The fixed history representation can feed a compact masked Double-DQN learner whose permitted action targets, bounded replay and optimizer/RNG state survive exact CPU resume.
dtype: float32 CPU after verifying canonical binary64 vector digest
reward: Only synthetic unit numbers in this preflight. Future bridge must compute unchanged R2 reward including post-assistance collisions; not implemented or measured by these checks.
sampling_and_exploration: Private CPU Torch generator for replay; private Python RNG for epsilon. No stochastic model layers. Caller global RNG must not advance.
terminal_rule: Only collision, collection or full time limit ends bootstrap. Assistance, epoch change, manual/disarm/cancel do not end physics or erase rewards; next epoch features must be cleared.
checkpoint_scope: Learner online/target/Adam/replay ring/private RNGs/counters plus explicit between-episode cursor. Not mid-episode Node plant/RNG restoration. Load CPU weights_only=True with trusted expected file hash and exact runtime/protocol/recipe/layout identity.
stream_scope: One bounded local Python process, maximum32 JSONL messages, original simulation clock/session/record/deadline, fail closed on duplicate/regression. Randomly initialized forward model only; forbidden-by-default validation-fixture reply schema; zero optimizer updates in stream.

test_recipe.inputs: tests/fixtures/navigation-dqn-vectors.json generated from hand-defined synthetic sensor/stream rows; no plant steps, trajectories, labels or datasets
test_recipe.bounded_updates: At most15 actual synthetic optimizer steps across all unit tests; target-sync edge uses an explicit artificial unit counter rather than250 extra updates.
checks: Permitted online argmax plus target value, not unmasked max
Terminal no bootstrap; nonterminal empty mask rejected
No operator request or expired reply
Consecutive original100ms records and cleared history at epoch transition
Bit-exact file resume of three subsequent actions/samples/losses/tensors/Adam slots
Persistent original-time Node/Python wire forward passes and cancelled/expired/duplicate proposals

gate: All18Python+4Node checks pass and upstream hashes unchanged. Approves only episode driver/reward/boundary/seed/budget protocol design before actual training; not automatic training, deployment or field use.
